note: 홈 리뉴얼 이미지 등재부. 여기 없는 슬롯은 같은 비율의 빈 프레임으로 렌더된다. 채우는 방법: make images (scripts/gen_images.py)

images.alt: 여러 화면에 흩어진 같은 영상 장면 가운데 하나에만 주황색 윤곽선이 그려진 그림
images.prompt: A wide, quiet grid of six floating video screens, slightly different sizes and tilts, hovering in a dark graphite void. Every screen shows the same abstract scene — a simple silhouette of a figure against a soft gradient — re-cropped, re-colored and degraded differently on each screen. Exactly one screen is traced with a thin glowing signal orange outline; all others stay muted grey. Subtle depth, minimal 3D render, matte surfaces, the screens arranged in a loose horizontal band across the middle of the frame.

images.alt: 우주데브리스 화면 예시 — 발견된 의심 링크가 목록으로 정리된 대시보드
images.prompt: A clean laptop screen mockup on a dark graphite desk, three-quarter view, showing a minimal web dashboard: a left column of small video thumbnails, a main list of rows each made of grey placeholder bars and a small thumbnail, one row highlighted with a signal orange marker, and a thin progress strip at the top. All interface text is rendered as plain grey bars, never letters. Soft studio light, shallow depth of field.

images.alt: 손에 든 화장품을 스마트폰 카메라로 비추자 제품 인식 박스와 성분 라벨이 나타난 장면
images.prompt: A hand holding a smartphone up to a plain unbranded cosmetic bottle held in the other hand, close-up, vertical composition. On the phone screen the camera view shows the same bottle framed by a thin signal orange recognition box, with three small rounded label chips floating beside it rendered as blank grey pills. The bottle itself is completely blank with no label. Only hands are visible, no face. Dark graphite background, soft rim light.

images.alt: 어두운 바탕에 옅은 영상 프레임 윤곽이 겹친 배경 무늬
images.prompt: An abstract, nearly black graphite background texture made of very faint overlapping video frame outlines and scan lines, low contrast, with one tiny distant signal orange glint off-center. Designed to sit behind white text, so the whole frame stays dark and even.

images.alt: 원본 영상 파일을 보관함에 올리는 그림
images.prompt: Step 1 of a series: registering an original video. A single matte graphite video file card with a small play triangle, sliding down into a shallow light grey tray, with a small signal orange upward arrow tab on the card.

images.alt: 흩어진 여러 영상 카드 가운데 후보 몇 장을 돋보기로 고르는 그림
images.prompt: Step 2 of a series: predicting where copies of content were re-uploaded. A loose scatter of small grey video thumbnail cards, with a graphite magnifying lens hovering over them; under the lens two cards are lifted slightly and tinted signal orange as candidates.

images.alt: 두 영상 카드의 지문 무늬를 겹쳐 맞춰 보는 그림
images.prompt: Step 3 of a series: fingerprint matching between two videos. Two thin translucent video cards standing side by side, each carrying the same abstract fingerprint-like swirl pattern made of concentric lines and a short audio waveform strip; a thin signal orange line connects matching points between them.

images.alt: 자물쇠가 달린 봉투로 한 사람에게만 알림을 보내는 그림
images.prompt: Step 4 of a series: sending a private alert through a secure channel. A closed graphite envelope sealed with a small signal orange padlock, resting on a light grey rounded phone-like slab, with a single small notification dot.
